text:
Based on the symptoms described—specifically the combination of a stiff neck, severe headache, high fever, photophobia (sensitivity to light), and confusion—the most likely medical condition is meningitis. This is a serious infection of the protective membranes covering the brain and spinal cord. Other possibilities could include encephalitis or a severe bacterial infection, but the classic triad of fever, neck stiffness, and altered mental status strongly points toward meningitis. Immediate medical attention is required.
